data.name: Bhargab
data.gender_notes: Bhargab is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: The name Bhargab is derived from the Sanskrit words 'bharga' meaning 'venerable' and 'ab' meaning 'father'. This name is given to a boy to signify that he is the revered one, a protector, and a respected figure. The name Bhargab carries the meaning “Bharga's Venerable” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Bhargab usually hope their child will grow to embody bharga's venerable and live with faith, good character and purpose.
